# The Concept Method

> Concept trains professionals who already speak English to use it at work. Its method teaches register, pragmatics, and timing under pressure. Concept works with professionals in São Paulo, Rome, and Milan, online or in person, for individuals and for teams.

Every program is mapped to the CEFR scale (A1 to C2). Lessons follow the Triple A cycle: Access, Analysis, and Activation. Between lessons, learners practice in the Concept Coach app with the Concept team, six AI coaches built on the Concept method, each responsible for one part of English. A free 45-minute diagnostic call comes before any program.

## Library

- [It's Not Only a Grammar Book, A1-A2](https://theconceptmethod.com/library/professional-english-practice-a1-a2/): Book 1 of Professional English Practice: forty-four units that repair the grammar you already half know, the wrong sentence printed beside the right one.
- [It's Not Only a Grammar Book, B1-B2](https://theconceptmethod.com/library/professional-english-practice-b1-b2/): Book 2 of Professional English Practice: forty units on the full past and future systems, modality, reported speech, and the structures of real fluency.
- [It's Not Only a Grammar Book, C1](https://theconceptmethod.com/library/professional-english-practice-c1/): Book 3 of Professional English Practice: thirty-six units on the verb system, modality, emphasis, cohesion, and register, for real control at C1.
- [It's Not Only a Grammar Book, C2](https://theconceptmethod.com/library/professional-english-practice-c2/): Book 4 of Professional English Practice: twenty-two units from aspect and formal conditionals to saying one thing three different ways, on purpose.
- [It's Not Only a Phrasal Verb List, B1-C2](https://theconceptmethod.com/library/phrasal-verbs/): Book 5 of Professional English Practice: phrasal verbs organized by particle, so the core meaning of up, out, and off carries across dozens of verbs.
- [Calibrated Speech, A1-C2](https://theconceptmethod.com/library/calibrated-speech/): A pronunciation manual sequenced A1 to C2 for Brazilian speakers of American English, built on two yardsticks: being understood and being taken seriously.
